note: Touchpoint patterns for docs/agents/kernel-line-regression.md section 1. A hit is a place to look, not a defect: the scanner answers 'which of our surfaces does this kernel-line move touch', and zero hits in a class mean only that the current patterns did not match. Keep patterns anchored to identifiers this repository actually uses — a pattern that matches prose produces noise and gets ignored.

classes.name: 组合层补丁行
classes.why: 行 id 会在 bundle 层之间移动，override 因此失去目标且静默 no-op

classes.name: 会话事件与投影
classes.why: 事件名与投影 stateVersion 变动不会让编译失败，只让监听器永不触发

classes.name: 服务键与 Remote
classes.why: ctx.get('键') 与 inject 里的字符串是类型看不见的运行期坐标

classes.name: 宿主目录直读写
classes.why: profile 布局、载荷目录与日志目录是外壳与内核之间的隐式契约

classes.name: 客户端注册面与工具注册
classes.why: 未声明的 slot 注册会抛、已退役的 slot 静默无操作，两者都不在编译期

classes.name: 自定义 HTTP / DOM / CSS 通道
classes.why: 注入的样式与脚本直接依赖宿主 DOM 与 token，宿主改版即静默失效

classes.name: 子进程与输出解析
classes.why: argv 形状、PATH 继承与退出码语义是跨进程契约，且随宿主环境变化
